description: Toxicity Vectors dome — spawned from Disease Vectors CAPACITY_SATURATED signal. Focuses on toxicological mechanisms, drug toxicity prediction, environmental carcinogen interactions, and cancer-toxin intersections.

parent_domain_lessons: Disease Vectors: pathogen-driven immune evasion mechanisms transfer well to toxin-driven evasion
ExMorbus (grandparent): literature synthesis at Haiku tier achieves >0.7 token efficiency
Diversity enforcement prevents convergence on single compound class

fitness_evaluation_criteria.novelty: Not present in provided toxicology literature corpus
fitness_evaluation_criteria.plausibility: Consistent with known toxicological mechanisms and dose-response relationships
fitness_evaluation_criteria.actionability: Suggests a testable in-silico experiment or literature gap to fill
fitness_evaluation_criteria.specificity: Names specific compounds, metabolites, genes, or molecular pathways
